title: Samudayadhammasuttaṃ
text: 180 . Sāvatthinidānaṃ . Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – ‘‘‘samudayadhammo, samudayadhammo’ti, bhante, vuccati. Katamo nu kho, bhante, samudayadhammo’’ti? ‘‘Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, samudayadhammo, vedanā samudayadhammo, saññā samudayadhammo, saṅkhārā samudayadhammo, viññāṇaṃ samudayadhammo. Evaṃ passaṃ…pe… nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī’’ti. Ekādasamaṃ.
